title: MoRTH Safe Axle Weights and Overloading Statutory Schedule
statutory_basis: Section 113, 114, 194(1), 194(2) Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended 2019); MoRTH Notification S.O. 2822(E)

penalty_parameters.offloading_mandate: Section 194(1)(b) prohibits vehicle from moving until excess weight is offloaded at owner/driver expense.
penalty_parameters.custody_provisions: Vehicle may be detained under Section 207 MVA until excess weight is unloaded and penalty deposited.

configurations.name: 2-Axle Rigid Truck (1 Steer + 1 Single Drive Axle)
configurations.description: Standard medium goods carriage; MoRTH 2018 notification increased max GVW from 16.2 to 18.5 tonnes.

configurations.name: 3-Axle Rigid Truck (1 Steer + Tandem Rear Axle)
configurations.description: Heavy commercial multi-axle truck; maximum permitted GVW is 28 tonnes.

configurations.name: 4-Axle Rigid Truck (2 Twin-Steer + Tandem Rear Axle)
configurations.description: Heavy haulage vehicle with twin front steerable axles; statutory limit 35 tonnes.

configurations.name: 5-Axle Rigid Truck (2 Twin-Steer + Tri-Axle Rear)
configurations.description: Heavy long-haul rigid chassis truck; statutory limit 43.5 tonnes.

configurations.name: 3-Axle Tractor-Trailer Articulated Combination
configurations.description: 2-axle prime mover tractor with single axle semi-trailer.

configurations.name: 4-Axle Tractor-Trailer Articulated Combination
configurations.description: 2-axle prime mover with tandem axle semi-trailer or 3-axle prime mover with single axle.

configurations.name: 5-Axle Tractor-Trailer Articulated Combination
configurations.description: 3-axle prime mover with tandem axle semi-trailer; high capacity container carrier.

configurations.name: 6-Axle Tractor-Trailer Articulated Combination
configurations.description: 3-axle prime mover with tri-axle semi-trailer; maximum standard highway transport capacity.
